note: Game-day active / inactive calls from RotoWire (ESPN athlete overview), for players designated Questionable / Doubtful this week and the QBs of a team whose QB is designated, published within 5 hours before kickoff. Sticky for the week; reset when the week turns. Consumers: inactive -> 0; active -> the measured if-played multiplier (Questionable Full 0.91 / Limited 0.88 / DNP 0.77, else 0.88; Doubtful 0.58).

00-0040719.name: Bhayshul Tuten
00-0040719.headline: Tuten (ankle/foot) is officially listed as active for Thursday night's game against the Ravens.

qbNote: QB starter calls from RotoWire, published since the team's last game: firm ("will start", "named the starter"), likely ("expected / in line to start"), not ("will serve as the backup", "won't start"); newest per QB. Consumers resolve per team: the newest start call names the starter (P start: firm 0.95, likely 0.85); a not call on the QB1 alone leaves him 5%.

00-0035289.name: Gardner Minshew
00-0035289.headline: Head coach Mike LaFleur announced that Minshew will step in as the Cardinals' new starting quarterback beginning with Sunday's game at Seattle, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

00-0035704.name: Drew Lock
00-0035704.headline: Lock (elbow) is slated to start Sunday's game against the Cardinals, perNFL reporter Andrew Siciliano.

00-0035710.name: Daniel Jones
00-0035710.headline: Head coach Shane Steichen said that Jones will remain the Colts' starting quarterback heading into Sunday's game against the Cowboys, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.

00-0038400.name: Tanner McKee
00-0038400.headline: McKee will shift to a backup role for Sunday's game against the Giants with the Eagles set to move forward with Joe Milton as their starting quarterback in Week 9, Adam Schefter of ESPN and Mike Garaf

00-0040981.name: Joe Fagnano
00-0040981.headline: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter confirmed Tuesday that Fagnano (ankle) will start Thursday's game against the Jaguars, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.
